## Changes

- Show unread results for open Chat panels in Thread View, and mark them read when the Chat is brought to the foreground.
- Restore running turns and Plan mode when reopening a thread, including streamed content and turn controls.
- Keep pending approvals available when a Chat panel closes so they can be answered after reopening it.
- Update compatibility for Codex CLI 0.163.0.
- Display retired Panel history envelopes as ordinary text instead of restoring their old reference links and context badges. Stored conversations and attachments are unchanged.
